note: The one contract for what every Herma page shares: the thin agent banner, the header, the footer and the asset URLs. The Python and Worker renderers both read this file, and a test fails if they ever disagree or if the asset versions below fall behind herma/static/assets (run python3 scripts/build_page_assets.py to refresh them). The banner is an instructions Task Object in the same shape Eranos and Agora use.

site.name: Herma
site.line: Herma sits between an agent's harness and its model.

footer.note: Herma sits between an agent's harness and its model. Agora explains how it works; Eranos is where the work happens.
footer.privacy: No analytics, ads or cookies, and nothing is stored in your browser. Fonts and scripts come from this site. We don't accept private information at this stage.
